schools.setup.errNoSchool: No school context — try signing back in.
schools.setup.errPickCourse: Pick a course for "{name}" — or clear the name — and we'll save the rest.
schools.setup.errStillLoading: Still loading your school — give it a moment and press Continue again.
schools.setup.invitesPending: Your invite links will appear here once your school is saved.
schools.setup.lede: Four steps. About ten minutes. You can come back and finish any time — we'll keep your place.
schools.setup.noCoursesAvailable: Your school doesn't have any courses available yet — get in touch with us and we'll sort it out. You can continue and add classes once courses are available.
schools.setup.noCoursesToChooseAfter: to pick which ones to use, or get in touch with us if your school has none available.
schools.setup.noCoursesToChooseBefore: No courses to choose from yet —
schools.setup.pageTitle: Let's get your school set up.
schools.setup.step2Lede: Share this invite link however you reach your staff — Teams, WhatsApp, in person. Clicking it signs them straight in. Anyone can teach: the app does the teaching, so a teacher doesn't need to speak the language.
schools.setup.step3Desc: Pick which languages to use for classes.
schools.setup.step3Lede: Pick which of your school's available courses you'll use for classes. This just narrows the list you choose from in the next step — it doesn't change who has access.
schools.setup.step4Lede: Name your first classes and pick a course for each. You can add students from each class page whenever you're ready.
